Phenyl alamine (Phe) and alanine (Ala) on complete hydrolysis. For this tetrapeptide, the number of possible sequences (primary structures) with <math> <mrow> <mo>−</mo><msub> <mrow> <mtext>NH</mtext></mrow> <mtext>2</mtext> </msub> </mrow> </math> group attached to a chiral center is.
